connectors.name: 12-pin side connector (left edge)
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark or numbers; the two ends are about equally distant from the USB-C connector, so ordered top to bottom (vertical row), matching the printed label list order.

connectors.name: BAT 2-pin JST connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; started at the end closest to the USB connector (right end).

connectors.name: SPK 2-pin JST connector
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; started at the end closest to the USB connector (right end).

uncertain: left-connector: the label list is drawn as a single block with one leader line to the connector, so the label-to-pin mapping (list top = connector top) is inferred; also both connector ends are roughly equidistant from USB-C, so the USB-nearest start end is not clear-cut (top used).
notes: Board silkscreen reads ESP32-C6-Touch-AMOLED-1.32. BAT and SPK 2-pin connectors have +/- silkscreen per pin and are included. Codec (ES8311), display (CO5300) and touch (CST820) GPIO tables, and the PWR (GPIO1) / BOOT (GPIO9) buttons, are not wiring points.
